items.title: Pay therapy invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: Private invoice between a company and a private person: period counted under §§ 187, 188 BGB from the stated start, the invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) 18.11.2026 (Wednesday). The day of the event (18.11.2026) is not counted, so the period starts 19.11.2026. The period is 21 days, so it ends 21 days after the start day, i.e. 18.11.2026 + 21 days = 09.12.2026 (Wednesday, since 21 days = exactly 3 weeks, same weekday). 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no § 193 BGB shift is needed.
